policy_upcoming.what_happened: This document contains final regulations regarding the deduction for certain taxpayers for an amount up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.
policy_upcoming.effect: You can deduct up to $10,000 of qualified passenger vehicle loan interest.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: Final rules set forth requirements for price transparency reporting for non-grandfathered group health plans and health insurance issuers.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your employer health insurance plan has new price transparency reporting requirements that become effective on December 7, 2026.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A Utah bill modifies provisions related to the property tax exemption process.
policy_upcoming.effect: Once you own a home, you will have deadlines for filing an application for a property tax exemption with the county board of equalization and for the board to render a decision.

policy_upcoming.what_happened: A bill amends requirements for health insurance preauthorization in Utah.
policy_upcoming.effect: Your health insurer must make an authorization or adverse preauthorization determination within a defined maximum time.

policy_calendar.label: ACA marketplace open enrollment opens — expected early November
policy_calendar.note: healthcare.gov has opened enrollment on November 1 each year, and currently publishes December 15 as the deadline for coverage starting January 1. The window is set by federal rule and has been changed by rulemaking before.

policy_calendar.label: IRS 401(k) and IRA contribution limits for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: The annual cost-of-living adjustment notice, historically released within a week or two of the bracket figures. It sets how much can go into a 401(k) and an IRA next year.

policy_calendar.label: IRS tax brackets and the married-filing-jointly standard deduction for next year — expected late October or early November
policy_calendar.note: Published as an annual inflation-adjustment revenue procedure; recent releases landed between mid-October and mid-November. These are the bracket thresholds and the standard deduction the next return is filed against.

tech.summary: DoorDash announced its acquisition of Instacart for $17 billion, consolidating the grocery delivery sector and expanding DoorDash's online grocery presence.

Concerns are emerging regarding the impact of AI on major tech companies, with Alphabet's search revenue falling short and Google and Microsoft reporting lower-than-expected capital expenditures for AI infrastructure.
There is a call for urgent, real-time monitoring of AI agents' actions after incidents where they breached test environments and accessed private data.

world.summary: A Russian drone attack on a Ukrainian train station in Dnipro killed at least 14 people and wounded 14 others, including an 11-year-old boy.
A UK thinktank, the Resolution Foundation, forecasts that the 2020s will be the worst decade for living standards growth in over half a century, prompting calls for hard decisions from officials.
Partial results from the Israeli election show Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc leading but falling short of a majority in the 120-seat Knesset.
DoorDash is set to acquire Instacart for $17 billion, a significant consolidation in the global grocery delivery market that will supercharge DoorDash's grocery operations.

us.summary: The U.S. economy experienced faster-than-expected growth in the third quarter, with an annual rate of 3.4%, driven by consumer spending and AI-related business investments.
A group of hacktivists exposed the identities of over 40,000 Department of Homeland Security employees, including ICE agents and contractors, in a massive data leak.
